text.en:
Using your Charged Melee Ability while sliding launches a <solar/>Solar Wave that travels 20 meters and applies 40 <solar/>Scorch (60 Scorch with <solar/>Ember of Ashes) to all enemies hit. Consumes 50% Melee Energy on use, and grants 25% damage resistance against non-Melee Combatant damage during the animation.

After launching the <solar/>Solar Wave, active your Melee Ability again to consume the remaining 50% and slam down, sending a second wave that travels the same distance, deals damage, and shatters <stasis/>Stasis Crystals. If this wave hits any <solar/>Scorched enemies, they instantly <solar/>Ignite.

Firing your weapon during the slide disables this ability.
